scalars.scalar_value: Experience in a Pulmonary or Sleep setting.
Minimum two (2) years of experience as a Medical Assistant.

items.item_text: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) OR Certificate of completion of a Medical Assistant training program.
BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Employee may be asked to float to other sites within Pulmonary and Sleep departments.

May also be required to work variable hours to help cover evening clinic hours to 7 pm as needed. Hours will be primarily 9:00 am - 5:30 pm with primary work location at our La Jolla office 4520 Executive Drive.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs and be able to work overtime as required.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Minimum two (2) years of experience as a Medical Assistant.
Experience in a Pulmonary or Sleep setting.
Experience scheduling patient appointments, chart preparation and managing in-basket messages.
Experience with EPIC and Cadence module.

Under direct supervision of the clinic manager and the general supervision of the clinic providers and licensed nursing staff, performs work which requires specific knowledge and training in patient care duties within the business and professions code of the State of California and/or the regulations of The Joint Commission (TJC).

These duties also include but are not limited to: scheduling of patient appointments and associated patient system screens; chart preparation; accurate billing; obtain prior authorization for medications; DME follow-up; managing in-basket message; environmental care functions; equipment/supply management; and cleaning/disinfecting the environment. Requires knowledge of medical terminology, online scheduling, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics. Position requires initiative, the ability to prioritize demands and the ability to work in a team environment. Other related duties as assigned.
Demonstrated knowledge of prior authorization for medications and DME follow-up.
Demonstrated knowledge of Medical terminology, on-line scheduling, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics.
Demonstrated ability to take initiative, prioritize demands and work in a team environment.
